review_locator: PMCID:PMC2846745, Eosinophil Survival and Apoptosis in Health and Disease; PMCID:PMC5803328, Eosinophils and Eosinophil-Associated Diseases: an Update
primary_title: Expression of Bcl-2 and its homologues in human eosinophils. Modulation by interleukin-5
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-5 reduces apoptosis of human peripheral-blood eosinophils and induces BCL2 mRNA and protein expression.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-5-associated BCL2 eosinophil survival-output bridge; retain the primary human eosinophil context and avoid transferring conflicting BCL2-family results.
